About

The man behind the vision

Dr. Kamau Wairuri is a researcher, educator and policy consultant with deep expertise in the politics of policing, violence and criminal justice in Africa, with a particular focus on Kenya.

He holds a PhD in African Studies from the University of Edinburgh, an MSc in African Studies from the University of Oxford, and a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science and Sociology from the University of Nairobi.

He is a Lecturer in Criminology at Edinburgh Napier University and a Research Fellow at the Institute of Public Policy and Governance at Strathmore University Business School in Nairobi. Over the past decade he has advised leaders across the public, private and development sectors on economic development, safety and security, youth and women empowerment, and human rights.
